resources.string: GT-BMS on GNU/Linux exchanges reports with the phone over your home network only, nothing goes to the internet. Open the sync, then enter the code on the computer.
Code to enter on the computer
Leave the battery to the computer
Most batteries take one connection at a time. While charging near the computer, the phone can let go of the link and take it back by itself afterwards.
Leave the link to the computer
The link is left to the computer until %1$s
